rule.name: two_lane_homogeneous_anchor_one_exchange_stars
rule.scope: exactly two identical lanes, the static nine-option catalogue, and the currently visible queue
rule.paid_seeds: all-idle plus one maximal feasible homogeneous frame attempt for each original catalogue option
rule.ordered_options: reuse the frozen v4 queue-local order: individually unavailable options last, then descending queue-weighted requirements, then original catalogue index
rule.directed_pairs: after seeds, maintain one cursor per individually feasible anchor; each cursor scans the same ordered catalogue and both heterogeneous orientations pay independently
rule.best_first_rule: pop the live anchor cursor with largest admissible suffix upper bound; heap ties follow deterministic insertion order induced by original anchor index
rule.free_skips: an anchor paired with itself is covered by its homogeneous seed, and an individually infeasible second option cannot form a feasible pair; both cursor advances are free
rule.paid_budget: K counts the ten seed attempts and each constructed or feasibility-tested directed heterogeneous pair at most once
rule.bound: each cursor upper-bounds all partners in its unvisited ordered suffix using duration-threshold weighted and coordinate maxima capped by the queue remaining after its anchor
rule.selection_tie: among paid feasible candidates, maximize support, then minimize frame duration, then the padded original-index raw lane tuple with idle ordered last
rule.support_argument: for two lanes, all-idle, maximal homogeneous seeds, and all directed pairs of distinct individually feasible options represent every support-relevant feasible frame
rule.exact_cap: 10 seed attempts plus 9*8 directed heterogeneous pair attempts equals K82
rule.exact_semantics: an admissible cursor upper bound at or below incumbent support may close early; exact certifies support only, so K82 duration, raw witness, and physical signature remain diagnostics rather than exactness gates
rule.excluded_claim: the one-frame support certificate does not establish completion-offset, FIFO-flow, mean-flow, or P90 improvement

known_pair_schema.identity: registered state index and exact queue plus baseline and variant FIFO-execution signatures; physical signatures and original-index raw lane tuples are retained separately
physical_signature: sorted completion-offset multiset for each class
fifo_execution_signature: per-class completion offsets concatenated in raw lane and option-local order
known_pair_schema.outcome_use: the completed quotient transition supplies only a roster of previously tested FIFO executions; a raw-only change stops without another drain only when its FIFO-execution signature is unchanged

advance_gate.known_action_veto: raw-only changes with unchanged FIFO execution and sets whose every FIFO-effective change matches one of the 16 completed quotient-transition executions stop; at least one new FIFO-effective pair is required to advance

stopping_rule: execute this frozen 5,003-state screen once; an invalid execution gives INVALID_EXECUTION and any pointwise or population regression gives REGRESSION_STOP; FIFO-equivalent raw-only changes or exclusively known FIFO executions give KNOWN_ACTION_STOP; without both strict primary gains give NO_GAIN_STOP; only a passing screen with both strict gains and at least one new FIFO-effective pair gives ADVANCE_AUTHORED_TRANSITION
prohibited_in_this_stage: arrival generation, trajectory simulation, policy feedback, new states or seeds, alternative orders, bounds or budgets, outcome-tuned filtering, confirmation outcomes, and paper edits
